name: SolveLevels
formula: =LAMBDA(length,[fall],[upstreamLevel],[downstreamLevel],LET(isInputFall, IF(OR(ISOMITTED(fall), fall = "", fall = 0, fall = "-"), FALSE, TRUE), isInputUpLevel, IF(OR(ISOMITTED(upstreamLevel), upstreamLevel = "", upstreamLevel = "-"), FALSE, TRUE), isInputDownLevel, IF(OR(ISOMITTED(downstreamLevel), downstreamLevel = "", downstreamLevel = "-"), FALSE, TRUE), numOfInput, SUM(isInputFall, isInputDownLevel, isInputUpLevel), CalFall, IFERROR(length / (upstreamLevel - downstreamLevel), "-"), CalUpstream, downstreamLevel + length / fall, CalDownstream, upstreamLevel - length / fall, IFS(numOfInput = 2, HSTACK(IF(isInputFall, fall, CalFall), IF(isInputUpLevel, upstreamLevel, CalUpstream), IF(isInputDownLevel, downstreamLevel, CalDownstream)), numOfInput = 3, EXPAND("Please Input 2 out of 3 Items", 1, 3, ""), TRUE, HSTACK(fall, upstreamLevel, downstreamLevel))))
comment: 'Input: Length in m. Fall (1:xxx). Upstream Level in mPD. Downstream Level in mPD. Fall, Upstream and Downstream --> Input 2 out of 3. Last Update at 2024-02-05
